entry.label: Practice: Viable System Model: diagnose functions and channels
entry.description: Choose a recursion, identify operational units, and test management functions without turning the VSM into an organisation chart. A basic organisational diagnosis. Functions can be distributed or combined in people and groups. The exercise does not establish that every multi-agency network has a single legitimate metasystem.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: State the focal system and one level above and below it.
Map the case evidence to Systems 1-5 and 3*.
Design a correction that preserves local autonomy.
Test the diagnosis with operational evidence.
